description: An attachment is not an input token, so `b` follows `a` (engine §4.2 and §6, case 41).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {item}
%rule item $w:w [$i:i]
%emits $w ($i)
%rule w "a" :: A | "b" :: B
%rule i "i"
%stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text a b
%rule a A
%conditions $.followed-by(b)
%rule b B
```
